basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 24-year-old student from Fayetteville, currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science at the University of Arkansas. I have a keen interest in 3D printing and often spend my weekends tinkering with my OctoPrint setup. I'm a night owl, so you'll likely find me online in the late evenings, usually between 9 PM and 2 AM. I'm a big fan of electronic music, especially while working on my projects. I'm currently single and focusing on my studies and hobbies. I occasionally browse subreddits for casual chats to unwind.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in computer science, primarily developed through my university studies. My passion for 3D printing led me to self-teach through online resources and forums, where I frequently exchange tips and tricks with other enthusiasts. I'm also somewhat knowledgeable about psychedelic experiences, thanks to a mix of online research and personal curiosity.
